title: Very cheaply made, came scratched as though used.
text: Very cheaply made, came scratched as though used.. This clock is very cheaply made and it arrived with scratches on it as though it were used. I would have returned it but I bought it at the last minute for my child to take to a Summer program. I'd but something else. Not worth the money AT ALL.

product_metadata.title: SHARP Small Digital Alarm Clock with Snooze and Battery Backup, Easy to Use Top Button Controls for Simple Use, Silver Case with Red Easy to Read LED Display
features: Digital alarm clock with a 0.6-inch Red LED display for easily checking the time at a glance
Easy to See and Easy to Access Top Button Controls for simple use

AC powered with Battery Backup. Battery back-up is used for storing the time and alarm settings if the power is interrupted. During battery backup the clock’s display will not be lit. Once the power is restored the display will re-light. Backup requires 1 x 9V battery (Not Included)
Clock Dimensions: 4.63” x 1.95” x 2.8” – The perfect size for a small and easy to use clock!
